title: PowerGrid: Integrations
summary: Feed machines, factories, terminals, logistics, and bases from a measured grid.

blocks.title: Connected Systems
blocks.body: Industrial Nexus and Logistics depend on reliable energy. TutorialCore can mark power alerts, Index can explain blocks, and Wiki pages can link machine symptoms to grid causes.

blocks.title: Practical Pairings
blocks.body: Feed Industrial Nexus machines, Logistics request blocks, MultiblockCore structures, and Terminal diagnostics with a grid that can explain its failures.

blocks.title: Fallback Play
blocks.body: Without linked dashboards, label cable runs and test one load at a time. Meters and breakers still tell the truth.

blocks.body: Use this reference when the related system is present; the manual path still works without it.
